# Pilot Jobs Network

> > A comprehensive aviation employment database connecting pilots with airline career opportunities, payscale data, and recruitment information across Europe, Africa, and beyond.

Pilot Jobs Network is a specialized job board and information resource for commercial airline pilots, aviation schools, and aviation professionals. The platform aggregates pilot job openings, compensation data, fleet information, and employment outlook across major European and international airlines and operators.

## Major International Airlines

- [Delta Air Lines](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/Delta_Air_Lines): Delta Air Lines USA pilot jobs, ALPA agreement and payscale data
- [Swiss International Air Lines](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/Swiss_International_Air_Lines): Swiss International Air Lines pilot jobs, payscales and GAV2023 info
- [Lufthansa City Airlines GmbH](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/Lufthansa_City_Airlines_GmbH): Lufthansa City Airlines A320 fleet pilot jobs and payscale database
- [Eurowings GmbH](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/Eurowings_GmbH): Eurowings A320 family aircraft pilot jobs and salary scale data
- [LOT Polish Airlines](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/LOT_Polish_Airlines): LOT Polish Airlines pilot jobs, payscales and employment information
- [SunExpress](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/SunExpress): SunExpress Turkey airline pilot jobs, payscales and employment outlook
- [Edelweiss](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/Edelweiss): Edelweiss Swiss airline pilot jobs and salary information in CHF

## Cargo & Freight Airlines

- [Condor](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/Condor): Condor airline pilot jobs, payscales, fleet (A330, B767) and employment info
- [Aerologic](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/Aerologic): Aerologic cargo airline pilot jobs, payscales and employment outlook
- [DHL Air UK](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/DHL_Air_UK): DHL Air UK cargo airline pilot jobs and UK payscale information
- [DHL Air (Austria) Gmbh.](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/DHL_Air_(Austria)_Gmbh.): DHL Air Austria cargo airline pilot jobs and payscale information

## Charter & Fractional Aviation

- [Netjets Europe](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/Netjets_Europe): Netjets Europe fractional corporate pilot jobs and payscale information
- [CLIPPER JET](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/CLIPPER_JET): CLIPPER JET fractional charter pilot jobs and payscales in Spain
- [Gainjet S.A](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/Gainjet_S.A): Gainjet S.A fractional corporate aviation pilot jobs in Greece
- [Enter Air](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/Enter_Air): Enter Air charter operator pilot jobs, B737 fleet and compensation data
- [German Airways](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/German_Airways): German Airways charter airline pilot jobs and payscale data
- [Neos](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/Neos): Neos Italy charter airline pilot jobs and payscale database

## Regional & African Airlines

- [Nesma Airlines](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/Nesma_Airlines): Nesma Airlines Egypt pilot jobs, payscales and aviation employment info
- [Air Cote Divoire](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/jobs/Air_Cote_Divoire): Air Cote Divoire Ivory Coast pilot jobs and recruitment information
- [Africa](https://www.pilotjobsnetwork.com/operatorlist.php): Directory of aviation operators and airline bases across Africa region
